closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, protein, and vitamin K, but the biggest weaknesses are low calcium, low vitamin C, and low fat quality. It is good for low-calorie volume, immune support, and blood and oxygen support because it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure, vitamin A gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, and iron supports the blood-and-oxygen side.
